seamlessportals.config.title: SeamlessPortals Settings
seamlessportals.config.maxLivePortals.to: Portals that show the other side live each frame (nearest first). Each one is an extra world render; the rest show a flat card.
Portals farther away than this only show a flat card.
seamlessportals.config.remoteRenderDista: How far you see through a portal. Never more than your own render distance.
seamlessportals.config.maxPortalSize.too: Portals wider or taller than this stay normal portals.
seamlessportals.config.portalParticles.t: Share of the swirl particles a see-through portal keeps.
seamlessportals.config.streamedPortalOpa: How strongly the portal's swirl or starfield shows over a live view. 0% is a clear window.
seamlessportals.config.offlinePreviews.t: On servers without SeamlessPortals: portals you've been through show the far side as you last saw it.
seamlessportals.config.offlinePortalOpac: How strongly the portal's swirl or starfield shows over an offline preview. 0% is a clear window.
seamlessportals.config.offlineCacheMb.to: Disk space for remembered chunks, per server. The least recently used go first.
